text:
Hannah Lee: posting a quick design pass on the routing policies editor: new ideas to help people compare pre/post reorder effects. Proto: https://figma.com/file/snapshot-scrubber. Key focuses: snapshot scrubber UX, preview diff affordances, compact validation placement, and keyboard reorder feedback.

Devon Park: really like the snapshot scrubber concept. small note: the scrubber thumb is tiny on touch devices. make it at least 28px and add a thin timeline tick for each saved snapshot.

Omar Aziz: preview diffs are cool but we need a visual legend that explains green=added, red=removed, yellow=changed. also include a tiny inline percent delta (e.g., "+12% matches") so users see impact at a glance.

Priya Patel: validation: prefer inline under the rule but collapsed by default. When a rule is invalid show a compact pill with an icon and short copy: "Matcher error". expanding it reveals details and examples. Keep the expand interaction keyboard-accessible.

AccessibilityBot: Keyboard reorder recommendations: Enter/Space to pick up, Up/Down to move, Enter/Space to drop, Esc to cancel. Announce using aria-live polite: "Picked up rule '{name}'", "Dropped '{name}' at position {n}". For the scrubber, ensure all ticks are reachable via the keyboard and have aria-labels like "Snapshot saved at 10:12 AM".

Hannah Lee: scrubber behavior: clicking a tick should load that snapshot in the preview; dragging the thumb should scrub live but throttle updates to 150ms. Also show a small delta badge near the scrubber when the selected snapshot differs from current order: e.g., "+3 rules changed".

Devon Park: UX for preview diff: when diffs are visible, freeze the main list scroll to avoid confusion. allow a close X on the diff inspector. Also microcopy for the inspector header: "Preview differences between current order and selected snapshot."

Omar Aziz: copy for the inline pill: "Matcher error. Click to view examples and quick fixes." and for the expanded detail show examples of common mistakes. keep each example one line.

Priya Patel: pin behavior question: should pinned rules be included in snapshots? My vote: include them but mark pinned rules in the diff as "pinned" and exclude them from auto-sort operations unless user unpins. That reduces surprises.

AccessibilityBot: color contrast check: diff red should be #B91C1C and not the current #F87171. Ensure labels use at least 14px semi-bold when paired with colored background.

Hannah Lee: decisions: 1) implement snapshot scrubber with 28px thumb, keyboard ticks, 150ms throttle, delta badge; 2) preview diff legend (green/add, red/remove, yellow/changed) with percent deltas; 3) inline collapsed validation pill with keyboard-expand; 4) include pinned rules in snapshots but label them and exclude from auto-sort; 5) freeze main list scroll while diff inspector open; 6) update color tokens per A11yBot. I'll update the figma and create tickets in routing-editor epic.

Devon Park: I'll mock the scrubber accessibility states and paste aria-label snippets.

Omar Aziz: I'll draft the diff legend copy and percent delta calculations for the devs.

Priya Patel: I'll create the validation pill component with expand/collapse states and short copy.

Hannah Lee: timeline: aim for grooming next week. tag me on PRs and include a short demo in the planning meeting. Thanks team :sparkles:
